name: Columbia (STS-93)
about: Columbia (STS-93) (1999-040A), a crewed vehicle (OV-102), launched 1999 Jul 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1999 Jul 25), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
